description: This file is a Perl script for manipulating NSLU2 firmware images, including reading, writing, and modifying firmware partitions, creating images, and parsing partition tables.

methods.name: padBytes
methods.description: Pads input data to a specified total length with 0xFF bytes, used for flash memory formatting.

methods.name: paddedSize
methods.description: Calculates the next multiple of block size greater than or equal to a given data length.

methods.name: numBlocks
methods.description: Calculates the number of blocks needed to hold a given data length.

methods.name: createPartitionEntry
methods.description: Creates a binary partition table entry with name, base address, size, and optional skip regions.

methods.name: parsePartitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a binary partition table entry into a readable data structure or detects termination.

methods.name: findPartitionTable
methods.description: Locates the partition table in firmware data if it exists, by identifying the 'RedBoot' signature.

methods.name: parsePartitionTable
methods.description: Parses a partition table buffer into a list of partition entries with metadata.

methods.name: jffs2Block
methods.description: Creates an empty JFFS2 block filled with specific pattern data.

methods.name: writeOut
methods.description: Writes data to a specified filename.

methods.name: trailerData
methods.description: Generates trailer data with embedded identifiers and versions.

methods.name: printRedbootTrailer
methods.description: Prints the parsed contents of the RedBoot trailer stored at the end of firmware data.

methods.name: removeOptionalLoader
methods.description: Removes the 'Loader' partition and adjusts offsets for Kernel and Ramdisk during firmware layout.

methods.name: spliceFirmwarePartitions
methods.description: Populates partition entries based on the firmware's partition table, overwriting or adding entries as needed.

methods.name: readInFirmware
methods.description: Reads a firmware binary file and populates partition data structures.

methods.name: writeOutFirmwareParts
methods.description: Outputs partition data to their respective files.

methods.name: readInFirmwareParts
methods.description: Reads partition data from files and loads into the data structures, supporting optional byteswap.

methods.name: layoutPartitions
methods.description: Calculates and assigns offsets and sizes for each partition to fit within firmware constraints.

methods.name: buildPartitionTable
methods.description: Constructs the binary partition table from layout data.

methods.name: writeOutFirmware
methods.description: Assembles firmware image from partitions and writes to a file.

methods.name: checkPartitionTable
methods.description: Performs a sanity check on a partition table data buffer.

methods.name: printPartitions
methods.description: Prints detailed information about partitions for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: defaultPartitions
methods.description: Provides a default set of firmware partitions with their standard parameters.
